paragraphs.text: Ford's thesis is that the best way to understand what particular fashions meant in any given era is to look at the restrictions placed on them. Through this lens, he shows us that the first laws passed in the 1200s to ensure that only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments reflected the rise of the middle class, who were now able to imitate some of these fashions. The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it.

analysis.translationNatural: Ford 让我们做几件事：别把习以为常的观念当理所当然（偏偏我们几乎从不反思），要明白再小的选择也带着含义，而含义又始终在变。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Ford】 _asks us_ (to question unconscious beliefs), (to realize that we almost never do so), (to understand that the simplest choices are charged with meaning), {and yet that meaning can and does change all the time}.

more.confusables: unconscious（无意识的；昏迷不醒的，形容词）/ be unconscious of（未察觉到，介词 of）/ subconscious（潜意识的）/ unaware（be unaware of，只作表语）/ the unconscious（潜意识，名词）

examples: Ford asks us to question unconscious beliefs, to realize that we almost never do so, to understand that the simplest choices are charged with meaning, and yet that meaning can and does change all the time. Ford 让我们做几件事：别把习以为常的观念当理所当然（偏偏我们几乎从不反思），要明白再小的选择也带着含义，而含义又始终在变。

underlying.sense: 潜在的、根本的、深层的、在下面的（underlying cause 根本原因）

more.confusables: underlying（潜在的、根本的，如 underlying cause，只作定语）/ underline（下划线；强调，动词）/ fundamental（根本的，近义）/ under- 表「在下面/不足」（underestimate、underpay）

examples: Ford takes the reader through the evolution of fashion while examining the underlying motivations of status, sex, power, and personality, which, he assumes, influenced all innovations in fashion in the past and which continue to influence us today. more.confusables: understand（理解、明白，及物，通常不用进行时）/ understand doing / understand that / make oneself understood（把意思说明白）/ comprehend（更正式）/ understanding（理解；谅解，名词）

examples: Ford's thesis is that the best way to understand what particular fashions meant in any given era is to look at the restrictions placed on them. Ford 的核心主张是：想知道某个年代的衣服代表什么，最该看的是当时对它立了哪些规矩。
